reviews.title: HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
reviews.text: I travelled with RwandAir from London Heathrow to Johannesburg in December 2023. I must admit I was initially apprehensive for 2 reasons: 1. December is usually a really busy time, so it’s more likely for things to go wrong in any airline 2. It was my first time travelling RwandAir and I had read some negative reviews. I am very glad I ignored the above and chose to travel RwandAir. The plane from London to Kigali was old but apart from that I had no complaints. The in-flight entertainment was great. The food was delicious and the staff was helpful and welcoming. (I do think they need to improve their earphones though as they are plastic and not very comfortable) The layover in Kigali was seamless for the most part. The security area was quite congested and a bit slow but once I got through that it was smooth sailing. The airport is small but clean and well kept. The staff in the airport were friendly and happy to help. The bathrooms were very clean and the lady working there was smiley and welcoming. All in all it was a relaxing stop over. We then departed Kigali and stopped over in Lusaka for passengers to disembark and to refuel. The plane for this part of the journey was also old but overall it was clean, in fact the bathrooms smelt sparkly clean. The crew was amazing, super friendly and attentive. After promptly refuelling in Lusaka we were off to Johannesburg and arrived 20 minutes ahead of schedule. My luggage arrived perfectly in tact and was on the carousel waiting for me — seamless! I would say overall that I did have doubts but that there was absolutely nothing to worry about. In fact it was an enjoyable experience and I would most certainly use RwandAir again. My family friend loves travelling RwandAir and I can see why. It’s not a virgin experience but it’s definitley comparable to British airways especially considering the price difference . I would recommend you consider RwandAir for your next flight
reviews.author: Simon

reviews.title: AVOID! AVOID! AVOID!
reviews.text: Avoid this airline if you do not want to waste time and money. They cancelled the flight just hours before departure! Had to find accommodation and another flight for the next day.
reviews.author: niera l

reviews.title: Avoid if you need to arrive on time
reviews.text: Landed late in Kigali for 90 stopover to be met with a 12 hour flight delay. Queued up at customer services only to be redirected to the information board, I quickly became one of the many passengers walking around the airport seeking assistance. Hundreds of passengers missed onward flights and weren't rebooked for same day flight so i was one of the lucky ones. In flight customer service was good and the entertainment was OK, Food was quite poor
reviews.author: Yaka M

reviews.title: RWANDAIR - UPCOMING AIRLINE
reviews.text: Departed a few minutes late due to ATC issues, but made up time en route. Crew friendly if a little disorganised. Food was very good, in fact too much of it, but nice. Drinks, just be sure to keep asking for what you want. Inflight entertainment was the weak link, dreadful audio selection with no named artists, assume to save on copyright, selection of movies was good, headphones good quality. Seat comfy, inflight announcements were informative, and clear. Overall I would recommend Rwandair in all areas, but they do need to sort out the inflight entertainment.
reviews.author: Simes1965

reviews.title: Shocking Airline
reviews.text: Avoid at all costs - kicked a friend of the flight as it was overbooked and took 2 and a half hours to deliver bags at Heathrow
reviews.author: Tom R

reviews.title: Better than their African airline  route rivals
reviews.text: My airfare was a real bargain as I fly to Harare 2-3 times a year ( having previously used Virgin / AIRLINK & Ethiopian Airlines . Great times for their flights from London to Harare ( for 11am the next day !) short stop over in Kigali . Personally they just need to tweak the Catering side of things ever so slight me to give them 10/10 Couple more selections of beer ( maybe a few snacks ? ) soft drink selection is very good Slightly better breakfast quantity would help Not leaving food trays with passengers as long as they do. Entertainment - Movies / music selection is fairly good variety Cleaning staff ( contractors? ) to pay more attention to detail ( dirty toilet extract fan - see photo Their hub Kigali is fairly decent gate / duty free area No real issues / dramas to mention on my first return trip over Easter with Rwandair .
reviews.author: M M

reviews.title: Worst Flight
reviews.text: Myself and family travelled on 14th December from Heathrow Airport to Nairobi. There's a 1.5 hr delay at check-in. We had a transit at Kigali and our flight was again delayed for 5 hrs. Rwandair lost my baggage and to-date , even after being advised to complete a claim form, no one has contacted me. Its as if my properties meant nothing and now opting to undertake a legal process. There was no choice for meals on our journey back to London. We were informed that the only meal available was fish whereas not everyone eats fish. I had the worst experience with this airline and advice people to avoid it.
reviews.author: Anne I

reviews.title: Better than I expected
reviews.text: I had fairly low expectations for RwandAir but I'm pleased to say they were significantly better than my expectations. The flight from LHR to Kigali was decently comfortable. Of particular note were the cabin crew who were highly professional and very friendly. The entertainment options were good too. The food was tasty, but there definitely isn't that much of it so I'd recommend bringing some snacks to keep you going. If you are connecting to RwandAir's other African destinations from Kigali, the experience is not as good. That's not to say it's bad, but you are on a smaller plane which definitely feels older and less well-loved. The staff are still just as helpful though. We were delayed on the flight back from HRE to LHR, and it seems this is pretty common for RwandAir. Kigali airport is very basic, but fortunately you won't have to wait in it long as you basically get off the main flight and onto connecting flights immediately.
reviews.author: Tom D

reviews.title: Rude and unhelpful staff
reviews.text: Rude and unhelpful staff. Flexible tickets, which are almost double the price, come with small print which effectively means you might as well not bother. Recommend booking with any alternative airline to save yourself a lot of money and hassel.
reviews.author: Tom B

reviews.title: Africa's Boutique Airline
reviews.text: Flew DOH-KGL March 2023 on a Qatar Airways award ticket. The B737-800 aircraft was aged; interior was at times taped together. Flight on time. Check In and transfers was difficult as Rwandair is less known by legacy carriers and even their QR partner could issue me a BP or transfer the luggage to Rwandair. Onboard, Rwandair delivers: good atmosphere, FA’s are plenty, attentive, professional, well-rested, and accommodating, e.g. allowing me for seat changes twice as I eventually found 3 seats in a row. They are generous on supplies throughout this night flight, e.g. at least 4 drink-rounds. Acceptable wines, Heineken beers, and a ½ liter bottle of water was provided to all. Food was again much better than most other airlines in economy: I had my pre-ordered special seafood meal served onboard as the first. Even QR First Class don’t provide that! More foods, including hot dishes, could be requested. The coffee served was a very good instant coffee from Rwandan “Gorilla’s Company”. Entertainment shared with one tiny monitor shared by 9 seats, no individual option. Headphone provided to those who wanted. Luggage delivered in Kigali 2 days later upon my consent at the gate as time of short transfer had almost elapsed and the incoming Qatar Airways delivering the luggage had refused/failed to relabel it prior to departure. In Kigali, I had to go through PIR reports and return to airport myself and pick the two items. Expensive tickets, but the airline is recommended as they render value and warm hospitality.
reviews.author: Anders P

reviews.title: Best Airline
reviews.text: I had the best experience using Rwanda Air from London Heathrow to Entebbe. One of the quickest Routes one can get plus great service. I will always fly Rwanda Air and looking forward to registering for Airmiles if available.
reviews.author: Faisal B

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs.
reviews.text: Easily the worst airline that I had the naive misfortune to select. Not only did they forward my return date by a day and were completely apathetic towards either apology or compensation for the extra day bnb in London that I had to incur,but the flight itself was torturous. The steward played hisxrandom selection of movie to all passangers.The same vile film was played to us in all it's inanity on the conbecting flight. Coffee had to be asked for,the midnight connection flight was almost impossible to catch due to the bottleneck of frantic custoners squeezing into 1 passport check booth at Kigali. Followed by 5 different officials demanding to see your boarding pass as the minutes to departure dwindled. but hey.the flight was delayed anyway. For 70 pounds more I couldchave chosen a trusted tried and true airline.
reviews.author: Jaroslav K

reviews.title: First and last flights with RwandAir
reviews.text: Previously I've always flown Kenya Airways on this route with the total journey time being around 15.5 hours. Decided to give RwandAir a try because of their quicker overall journey times of approx. 2.5 hours less. However, the experience was very disappointing compared with KA, so much so that I'll be going back to the longer journey time for a better experience. The fully flat business class seats on the LHR-KGL leg are superb and allow a great nights sleep. The cabin staff are friendly and helpful but unfortunately that's where the good bits end. On 2 of the 4 four flights involved in this return trip a Gin and Tonic could not be served due to having 'run out of tonic', on one leg the business class toilet light would not come on when the door was closed leaving it so dark I couldn't see the toilet flush button until I'd opened the door again, on another the toilet ran out of hand drying towels which were not replaced for 2 hours, there are no printed meal menus the cabin crew have the offerings hand written in an exercise book where they record each passenger's choice. Worst of all is the appalling quality of the food. By the time of the third flight I'd given up on eating on the plane opting to eat in the lounge before departure. To show how bad the food is I offer this photo of an Egg Florentine for breakfast. It must have taken 30 minutes on high in a microwave to reach this level of destruction! So much lacking and all at a cost of several $100 more than a KA business class return was priced at for the same travel dates.
reviews.author: indetraveller

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Flights were on time and comfortable, food was nice and service from all staff was excellent. Very short stop over in Kigali, quick transfer. Excellent value for money.
reviews.author: Kathryn D

reviews.title: Terrible airline, never again!!
reviews.text: On both flights, going and coming back; it was delayed and we arrived to our destination late. It was even worse coming back because it was delayed for 2 hours. I’m a vegetarian and payed £12 for the meal through a website called my trip, because that’s where I booked the tickets from and the food I was given was definitely not £12 worth, it was so disappointing; especially since I had the first one for Christmas dinner! Even just trying to get the baggage was such a hassle, it was so disorganised! ALSO DO NOT BOOK THROUGH MY TRIP! When I went on the my trip to check in, it says that it was gonna cost for me to do so, when stuff that is usually free. So I went on the Rwanda air website, and it then allowed to me check in for free.
reviews.author: Tee L

reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: Worst experience ever, never again I’m I flying with this airline. Delays and lost of luggage. Fly with them at your own risk. Rwanda air doesn’t deserve to be an international airline. TERRIBLE.
reviews.author: Mateen

reviews.title: Worst flying experience in decades of travel
reviews.text: I am extremely upset and disappointed over the service that was provided to me as a paying customer of 4 round trip tickets. I purchased my tickets through an agent, and on returning to our destination, we discovered that the Ebola Travel advisory required that we be re-routed to one of 5 airports in the US of which our airport was not. This was not brought to our attention and was not our making. I contacted the Travel agent and they said that all they will need from the airlines is a note from Rwandair posted to our reservations, authorizing CheapOair to make changes to the reservation at no cost to me because the requirement to re-route is not my making and came into effect after we had purchase our tickets. Rwandair refused/declined to do that for me. Our luggage did not arrive on time either, one set up to 3 days after arrival. One of us traveling earlier had a flight cancelled yet no one got in touch with us regarding the canceled flight. This experience turned out to be very expensive as we ended up having to buy new tickets from different airlines because we had to get back to work and college on or close to the originally planned dates. If you do not walk into an office, it is extremely hard (did not happen for us) to catch anyone on the phone.
reviews.author: Padu L

reviews.title: Worst airline on earth
reviews.text: They charged us for seats cause we require a bassinet to only get on the flight to have a fight about seating arrangement, me and my partner had 4 check in bags 3 were damaged missing wheels, my hard case was cracked. In a nutshell I would rather walk next time than fly this airline
reviews.author: Brilly B

reviews.title: Africas Boutique Airline?
reviews.text: Kigali-Doha 28 Dec. 2022 on an aged B737-800. Ticket issued by the partner airline Qatar Airways (QR): the cooperation is smooth though fragile and not always clear. I checked in in KGL beyond Doha to Bangkok and luggage was kindly inscribed further to Saigon with Vietnam Airlines so I could stay airside in BKK. Denied lounge access in Kigali despite gold status at both QR and BA. That privilege is not clear for economy codeshare flights: this was 1st time out of 4 recent economy flights they have rejected me free lounge access. Security checks when going to gate was nitty gritty and they took every item out of bags. Boarding by foot, 200 m, was a breeze. Given an exit seat while boarding but took the liberty to choose instead the last empty row to stretch out during the night. Flight on time. Onboard, the FAs are stunning, energetic, observant, polite, and truly caring. Call-bells answered throughout. My preordered seafood meal was provided with precision, ease, and care. It was a big portion with wildcatch ocean fish - delicious for economy travel. With pleasure, I also tried other hot dishes offered. Drinks and food generously provided, apparently ad libitum. Food filling and more or less on par with SWISS and KLM business class. A cheese platter was added to my menu as a courtesy upon request. It is becoming a pleasure to fly again, but I can fault missing IFE (shared screens/no sound) and WiFi. This aircraft type is extremely noisy. Landed in Doha for tedious, almost depressing, embarkation by bus to terminal.
reviews.author: Anders P

reviews.title: Luggage follow up is terrible.
reviews.text: Nairobi office luggage follow up is terrible. Flew in on 20th till today 28th I have not received my luggage. Buggage claim lines no one is answering.....been trying to get through for hours...Nairobi office customers service is the worst.
reviews.author: sarah

reviews.title: Flight cancelled with no communication
reviews.text: I was due to fly with this airline as part of a 3 stop trip. When I arrived at Harare airport I was told that the flight that day had been cancelled. Though the airline had both my email and mobile number, no attempt was mad e to contact me. The 2 stars awarded are for the very efficient and helpful staff member at Harare who was able to get me a seat on the only other flight to Cape Town that day.
reviews.author: Deirdre

reviews.title: Worst Flying Experience Ever!
reviews.text: Worst flying experience ever! This is the worst airline I have ever come across. (And I haven’t even boarded the plane yet) If you are trying to make a trip to see loved ones you haven’t seen since before the pandemic or trying to make it to an important appointment on time (I am trying to do both) DO NOT fly Rwanda air! The customer service personnel are rude (they hung up on me several times, and they choose what to listen to and what to leave out- I was calling internationally to make what should have been a simple ticket change. They claimed I had already made a change to my ticket and therefore had to pay for the change (A lie)- Even with proof provided they chose to ignore this and charged me the cost of another ticket! Furthermore, days before my flight from DC to Harare, Zimbabwe, I received a weird text message from what I assumed was the airline, saying one of the legs of my flight was cancelled- The Kigali to Harare leg. (This is a problem because I have an important appointment to get too upon arrival). I asked the airline if the change was real because I had not received any emails confirming this change, what’s more they are saying the change is real and I will be stuck at my layover for 48 hours! My flight is tomorrow December 9 2022 and because of this change it will take me 4 days to get home. That’s a good chunk of my trip gone! I have been trying to contact the airline for the past few days, loosing out on sleep trying to call them in their time zone during business hours. I am very frustrated because management will not help me and frankly do not care. I can clearly see there are flights to Zimbabwe on the day I was supposed to arrive at my destination. I am usually not one to write bad reviews but I want to put this out there to warn people not to gamble their travel plans on this airline. Noone will accommodate you. You are on your own!! I am never booking them again and will advise anyone considering them to support other airlines that will treat you like a human being in the very least.
reviews.author: C. Jakazi

reviews.title: Rubbish from start to finish.
reviews.text: This is by far the worst airline. I am 42 and have travelled my whole life. Was supposed to fly through Kogali for a 1 hour stopover on a Sunday but flight got cancelled and put on Monday, arriving Tuesday morning. Boarded fine and a mess up in baggage meant we sat in the runway for 4 hours. This was announced by the pilot. By the way there were people who had been delayed since the previous Monday as they cancelled a flight then too. Obviously missed my connection and the staff in Kigali started lying telling us the delay was a technical fault. They also informed us there was no flight until Thursday. They put us up on a hotel which was the only positive. I'm sitting here on Kigali Airport fuming as there's tiny TV telling is our next flight has been delayed by an hour. Not 1 announcement from a member of staff. Most rubbish airline I have flown and by my count I'm well above 15. Avoid as much as you can. Sh@t show, incompetent and unprofessional. They should not be allowed to operate.
reviews.author: Andy M

reviews.title: Save yourself the headache
reviews.text: Horrible, poor customer service, cancellation of flight days before trip and no help rebooking. Customer service is non-existent. Worst airline ever. Horrible, horrible.
reviews.author: Margaret

reviews.title: Worst flying experience ever.
reviews.text: Cancelled flights, massively delayed flights. Worst airline I've ever used and would absolutely not recommend them.
reviews.author: Russell T

reviews.title: Oh my dayzzzz
reviews.text: Question is what went right. If this airline is the pride of Africa I'd rather ride a donkey. The worst unorganised airline I have ever flown. Used them twice and to be honest this will be the last. They never on time. No Comms. Terrible service and most uncomfortable seats in the world. I'm sure they took them off an old bus.
reviews.author: Rubbish

reviews.title: Yeah, don't give these guys a cent of your cash or time.
reviews.text: The single worst experience ever with a commercial entity. Do not, under any circumstances fly with these guys.
reviews.author: Mirhire

reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: I won't recommend this airline due to being disorganised. They changed flight times about 5 times and on the final the flight was delayed after changing the flight date also.
reviews.author: simon m

reviews.title: Poor communication
reviews.text: I was supposed to fly from Malawi to Rwanda (Kigali) on Monday 21 November, and I had to fly from Blantyre to Lilongwe (Malawi), Harare, Lusaka to be able to catch the plane to Kigali with Rwandair. I went through this hassle because then at least I could arrive in the evening (21.30h) and have a normal night rest. I paid around 300 euro extra for that purpose. When I arrived in Lusaka, they informed me that my flight to Kigali was cancelled. I ended up travelling via Addis, to arrive 00.45h in Kigali, arriving around 02.00 at my guesthouse. I am very dissappointed that I wasn't informed in time, so I could have been flying Blantyre, Addis, Kigali. I complained at the customer service. They apologised and were friendly, and gave me an email address to claim back my extra costs. Let's see if that is going to work. Currently i am awaiting a Rwandair flight from Kigali to Kamembe (west Rwanda), supposed to be flying at 07.00h. Because of problems with their aircrafts we have to wait for an aircraft to arrive from Kenya (supposed to arrive at 5.45am, but scheduled to arrive at 09.09am). I was planning to facilitate a workshop today. This is going to start late. They told me this is a temporary problem, and should be sorted once their aircrafts are repaired. What about hiring another aircraft in the meantime? I had a positive experience with Rwandair in the past, so let's hope they get back on their feet.
reviews.author: Ditteke d

reviews.title: An airline that doesn't communicate
reviews.text: Had a flight at 5pm, then the plane didn't arrive, then scheduled at 3am! Then delayed to 5am, still sitting on the tarmac at 7am. Through all this, the airline did not once communicate in advance with passengers to limit the inconvenience, to avoid people arriving at the communication is poor. Very unprofessional. Avoid!
reviews.author: Matt

reviews.title: Terrible airline - stay away
reviews.text: This airline was late on two occasions, when I was travelling to Kenya and returning. They changed my ticket over 3 times during my stay in Kenya and have delayed it server also times. The airbus also smells terrible on the inside, seats are garbage and they need to refund me for the tickets they changed multiple times. I would absolutely NOT recommend flying this airline if you’re going to Africa. Stick with either Kenyan airways or Ethiopia air.
reviews.author: Hana

reviews.title: Terrible customer care
reviews.text: Customer service is poor - no sense of urgency and the responses are neither transparent nor fully informative. I canceled a reservation within 24 hours of payment. To my horror, I discovered the customer call centre they have is in Kigali. This number was not in use! I managed to get email addresses to contact from their office at CPT airport and their official twitter account. However, the responses to my email requests for a refund were lethargic and not transparent. It has now been 3 days and all I know is that the tickets I bought were non refundable. and that only airport taxes are refundable. I was not given information as to how to start this process. My booking references are non existent and I am stuck in limbo not knowing the options available to me at this time. You will note that their ticket price does not include a breakdown of these costs and this complicates matters. So their twitter page advised me to wait for the breakdown. I have also been informed that I will be penalised for rescheduling. If you want value for your money, use other airlines. A friend of mine got her money back after canceling Airlink flight 48 hours after booking minus all these hassles I have been through. Besides that, their flights have been delayed on some trips i have taken with them and their engine is noisy especially if u sit at the back. In summary, Rwandair is not value for money and Airlink is cheaper and hassle free for those doing the CPT-HRE route. "
reviews.author: Danie M

reviews.title: This Airline Stoled my money
reviews.text: I have called them over 100 times, and I sent them over 120 emails not a single reply back from them. They cancelled our trip without any Hesitation - they stoled 1,870 $$ USD from us, now I have to rebook another flight with a different airline. This Airline needs to be shut down and out of business completely, they are stealing from customers, I have reached out to refund department no reply…I just can’t believe this. I will never fly with any African airlines, RwandAir is F***King trash. They have no customer service at all whatsoever, they are scamming people out of their hard earned money. F***k Rwanda Air, and I hope they read this review. If I can give them negative 1 billion rating I will. I do not recommend a soul to fly with this airline. If you booked them for trip good luck, they are absolutely trash.
reviews.author: Lassanah G

reviews.title: Very bad customer service
reviews.text: I booked my ticket for 13th November from Harare to Nairobi for me and my 4 yrs old daughter ,the airline has changed my flight to 15th November without my consent with layover of 10 hrs,my initial booking was with a layover of 3hrs. They haven’t reached out to me on how I will manage a long layover with a baby. Calls are not answered, emails are not responded to.This is bad experience ever. I don’t think I will ever take Rwandair or recommend to anyone,they don’t have a sense of humor.
reviews.author: Beverlyne K

reviews.title: Not the greatest
reviews.text: I was disappointed as I could not book my seat online. I did order a seafood meal, but did not get one. There were no bottles of water, only plastic cups. We were not offered drinks during stopovers in Lusaka and Brussels. The earplugs were not great, and did not fit properly in the ear. Seats did not recline. Meals were tiny. Kigali terminal was small, no seats to sit, no shops in the departures. Incorrect information given over the speakers for flights.
reviews.author: 247LiveLife

reviews.title: Pleasant flight
reviews.text: Lusaka to Kigali 12 October 2022. Few days before departure I contacted the airline’s office in Lusaka as the flight appeared not to be to sold anymore and hardly could be full. They answered back within 1 hour and gave detailed confirmed, entire itinerary (incl. coming flights). Check-in counters opened pleasantly early, 3½ hour prior departure, so no queues or waiting time. The man at counter advised on seating and showed me configuration and options on his computer. We selected the best options, though I was later further upgraded onboard to have the most spacious seat in economy. Security, health documentation, immigration took less than 10 Minutes. Their partnership with Qatar rendered me access to Pearl lounge in the terminal. There was some discussion whether I was qualified, but in 5 Minutes after some photocopying, they let me in. The lounge is 3rd party, and acceptable with Wi-fi, hot foods, wines and cold beers. Onboard, my preordered special meal though I had to remind them, and it took some time to avail it. Drinks and customer care onboard was very pleasant, nothing was too much, but it took a lot of time as the FAs discussed and recommended drinks to almost every passenger. IFE was only a flight monitor, but the music channels offered a lot. Had to use own headphones. No WiFi, old aircraft, but well maintained. Good announcements from pilots. Noisy aircraft, this B737-800. Flight on time, we arrived 15 Minutes earlier than scheduled. Luggage arrived before I even passed immigration. DreamMiles to their FFP was given me after just 1 day after landing. Recommended.
reviews.author: Anders P

reviews.title: Russian roulette. Always hit and miss with this airline
reviews.text: Pros staff are polite and nice. Some times the food is good at times terrible not consistent Smoking booth in lounge if connecting through Kigali Cheaper than most airlines to east and Southern Africa Cons -Always late take off and taxi. -Your luggage will be battered mangled and destroyed.They managed to destroy two of my bags despite being wrapped. -Had a roach climbing me whilst on the flight -Might take you 3 hours to collect your luggage at T3 Heathrow. Not great after a 17 hour flight. -No visible representative at T3 Heathrow airport baggage claim. -Flight times do change a lot especially for those with advance tickets. - issues with toilets as they are usually messed up during the flight - exit door food trays are worn cracked and broken In conclusion if you are not flying first class avoid this airline.
reviews.author: Frank M

reviews.title: Love and care their passengers
reviews.text: Flew DOH-KGL-LUN 10-11 Sept. 2022 on two different B737 versions. This, in conjunction with QR from Bangkok. QR is new partner of Rwandair and it functions despite some hiccups on ticketing, pricing, FFP. Partnership with Qatar Airways is incomplete and unclear: e.g. issued tickets are only partly compatible and manageable on both airlines. Granted lounge access in Doha after a short discussion and some photocopying. Both flights on time. Very noisy aircrafts, very limited IFE. Food very good, as always. Special meal delivered to perfection. Additional meals were offered and I tested them as also being good, and well cooked. FA’s are very friendly and caring, all stunning elegant, more than 6 feet tall, well rested, humorous, and confident. Transfer in Kigali smooth, was granted access to Pearl lounge after a short discussion (not clear whether a QR gold card gives you access as most QR-frills do not apply for their partners like smaller, non-OneWorld airlines). Luggage: no issues. Flights on time. IFE poor but present. Manage to change FFP from Qatars’ Priv. Club to Rwandairs’ Dream-Miles at the gate in Doha to maximise earnings on both programs. The airlines’ frequent flyer programs are reciprocal only within limitations, thus I had to split the Mileage earnings to 2 programs according to sectors.
reviews.author: Anders P

reviews.title: Ms
reviews.text: I've travelled with Rwandair about 8 times this year and every experience has been wonderful. They are the most child friendly airline that I've been on, they are warm, patient and kind toward parents with kids. Recently I flew alone with my two toddlers, once the staff noticed that my kids were irritable they immediately stepped in to speed up the check in process, to take my bags for me to the boarding gate so that I could carry my babies, then on the airline they constantly checked in on me, lent an extra hand where I needed it and treated my kids with kindness. On a previous flight when my little kid was still an infant, the air host made the effort to offer an easier seat, helped me move and assured me that he was available at any time I needed a hand, he meant it. The food is good too!
reviews.author: Raeesa T

reviews.title: 5 Star Service
reviews.text: On time and good customer service. Keep it up and will definitely be using you often. Will definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Jessica Jacobs

reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: Travelled to Harare with this airline and lost 3bags out of 5 on arrival. There is no sympathy or apology from staff when we were trying to locate our baggage. One member of staff called it normal and appeared unapologetic instead we seemed to be the problem making efforts of locating our baggage. We got 50USD which didn't meet our needs as a family of 5. The staff would promise to contact you and you don't hear from them. The only person who was responsive is James Nkurunziza by email. At least he expedited for us to get our baggage. I have young children and will not use this airline or recommend anyone to use it. When coming back to the UK the flight was delayed and the kids got so irritable. My son and hubby were moved from their seats to accommodate another family. Shocking!!!
reviews.author: Edith M

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Our experience with Rwandair was honestly brilliant, staff were lovely food was good but what let them down was that on arrival im Harare they lost all our luggage - 6 bags in total. We were told we MIGHT get them on the next flight in 2 - 3 days. As we were travelling on from Harare the next day for 7 days we had to rush around and buy necessities and clothes for 7 days for 3 people, this was a huge expence to an already costly holiday. On flying back to the UK 3 weeks later, our luggage was lost again this time 2 suitcases. All travellers who didn't get luggage were travelling from Harare. It is unacceptable for an airline to be leaving luggage behind especially due to the cost of air tickets and the inconvenience it is causing people who are using this service. It is incredibly disappointing as the cost of the flight and the time taken to travel suited us very well however I am not sure we will fly Rwandair again because of this. One incident of lost luggage is tolerable but to happen twice on the same trip is not acceptable. Still waiting too be informed as to when our luggage will arrive. No communication from them to us until I emailed to find out what is happening and currently have no idea when our luggage will arrive. They will be in touch......waiting patiently.
reviews.author: shellbellzim

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: I've flown with Rwandair multiple times over the last few years now, and whilst they don't have all the frills, they have always had good service, comfy seats and been great value... until today. Travelling with my 4 month old baby, I stood for over an hour at the check in desk (this doesn't include waiting to be served), we were late departing, snotty service on board, warm drinks and a shambles as far as seat allocations were concerned. Delayed in Kigali, chaotic connecting flight to Harare and to top it off, not one of our family's 7 checked bags arrived. Apparently over 70 bags were deliberately left in Kigali, surely thats half the plane? Speaking to locals, this is apparently a routine occurrence, leaving a permanent sea of luggage (missed off the previous flight) waiting for collection. Not a sole around to help or advise, no offer of compensation and not even the hint of an apology. I am appalled and do not believe they should be able to get away with this.
reviews.author: jay_hospitality

reviews.title: I was bullied by the airline
reviews.text: I was supposed to fly to SA on the 25th but there was an issue with my visa because it was hand written and some parts were badly filled out, like they rushed it. So that airline, ASKY said I would have to go back to the SA embassy to rectify the problem - that was how I missed that flight, then yesterday, I went and got the visa corrected at VFS and also got an email from the SA embassy validating the visa in case anyone asked questions. I got to the airport, but the next ASKY flight to SA would be on Thursday, so the organizers of the program I'm going for, booked a one way flight on Rwand Air so I could fly yesterday. The lady looking through my papers noted the changes on the visa and I showed her the email. She took it to her boss and came back and nothing more was said about the visa. Instead, they looked at my flight itinerary and said my return ticket had no ticket number - the return ticket is with SAA. I got the organizers to send the ticket number but the lady at the desk said her boss said I must get a return ticket with Rwand Air and she said I should wait to appeal to the boss. I kept waiting and he didn't come. That was when I finally lost it and sat on the floor and raked for them but no one answered me. Until I took a video of them, saying what they had done to me. Then the managers and officials of the airline and FAAN came and the issue now became about me making a video and that was basically what I was punished for. I was taken to their crime unit and they got even more upset that I tweeted about what was happening to me. So I was detained for long then taken the police station and accused me of unruly behaviour and of bringing 'doctored' visa and the airline manager now appeared and said he was trying to explain to me that the issue was with the visa and that I could be sent back by SA immigration and if that happened, then I would have to buy a ticket with them and claimed that I refused to listen to anyone. These were all lies. No one told me anything about my visa still being the issue - they just said I had to buy a new ticket. I wasn't allowed to say my side of the story. It was only Rwand Air, the police and airport officials talking and accusing me of all sorts of things and making me, the victim, into the villain. Then they forced me to write an apology letter at the police station after threats of jail or a fine of 250,000. They made me take down the video and tweets and make another video debunking the firs video. Then they let me go. The Rwand Air manager was 'magnanimous' enough to say that they could let me fly the next day, but I must sign an undertaking that if I am sent back by SA immigration, I must pay for my return ticket. I have chosen instead to stay in my house
reviews.author: Omotunde A

reviews.title: Greedy and dishonest
reviews.text: Horrible airline. I purchased a ticket which was supposedly changeable for a $50 fee. When I needed to change dates, they would not give me flight credit to rebook myself and kept quoting me prices that were two or three times higher than what I could see on their website. The fee to change suddenly became the entire amount I had already paid $400. I cut my losses and will never book their flights again. Plus, their flights are over priced. You're better off booking KQ or air Tz and Uganda airlines.
reviews.author: Sheila T

reviews.title: WORSE EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: Terrible as check in took us more than 5 hours. Avoid rwandair by all cost. 3hours waiting to board in to no avail. Worse customer service as there is no information from the team 🙄🙄😡😡😡
reviews.author: e L

reviews.title: Damage to Luggage and poor response
reviews.text: The flights and service were great but the follow-up just reeks of disinterest. Upon arrival at Entebbe, I found that both of my suitcases had been extensively damaged. I made a complaint at the airport and filled some forms. Two weeks later I had heard nothing so attended Rwandair office in Kampala. They knew nothing of the problem. I filed a second return and waited. Following assurances of attention and an agreement to pay compensation (about 1/2 what the cases were worth) two months have passed and nothing. The local reps are just disempowered drones who say one thing and then do nothing.
reviews.author: Ian P

reviews.title: Disappointed by service
reviews.text: Yesterday me and my brother travelled to Zim. We didn't find one bag on arrival. Speaking for myself this is really hurtful. My brother doesn't have any clothes to change as we speak. The worst thing is noone from the airline was there/made any effort to communicate what might have happened with our bags. Noone communicated properly when we can expect our bags. A huge company providing services to many people should at least show some concern for customers and communicate any inconveniences. We were made to fill forms by some agents at the airport who didn't seem have much knowledge on what we should expect because there was noone from the airline to help. Can we at least know how we can be sure that we receive our bag on Wednesday and what time. Because the service seems unreliable. How can we know where our bag is and if it's safe. Was my first time travelling with Rwandair and I must say such a disappointing experience. Bags get lost/don't get packed but it can be better if someone can communicate to clients. We were desperate for some assistance at the airport and couldn't get any.
reviews.author: Rudo D

reviews.title: Most horribly customer service I have ever encountered
reviews.text: My flight by Rwandair got cancelled early March: they let us wait for 6 hours in the airport (after supposed departure time) without any information ! This is not how a decent airline is expected to treat its customers . We got booked on a new flight two times, meaning two times, we got back to the airport to find out completely at the end, before boarding, that we could not board the other aircraft as the flight was fully booked. I never experienced this ever before in my life (and have been going thorugh quite some candellatuobs so far). Moreover, I tried claiming a refund but customer service is almost unreachable and tries to avoid responding my questions. They say it is not possible to claim a refund etc. nor refund costs incurred for excess luggage at another airline (where they rebooked us on), but when I ask where I can see proof of this statement, all goes silent and I don't get answers anymore. Hence I highy doubt their fairness in way of approaching refunds/claims etc. Just a message: please, be aware when you are flying this company and better don't do so, in order not to experience the same hassle as I unfortunately encountered. I learned a valuable lesson not to fly ever again with a company of cheaters like this one, at least...
reviews.author: DirkDR

reviews.title: Fly RwandAir and lose your luggage.  They are really bad when it comes to luggage and compensation.
reviews.text: Fly RwandAir and lose your luggage. They are really bad when it comes to luggage and compensation. Following the loss of my luggage, I have submitted letters to their offices in Harare and THEY SIMPLY DO NOT RESPOND.
reviews.author: Thomas M
